name: JagoOngkir
author: tatakode

sections.description:
JagoOngkir is a WooCommerce shipping-rate plugin for Indonesian online stores. It displays shipping rates from multiple courier services on WooCommerce Cart and Checkout pages using api.co.id, RajaOngkir, or Biteship.

Features

  • Display provider rates for the courier services you select.
  • Support three Indonesian shipping APIs: api.co.id, RajaOngkir, and Biteship.
  • Select provider-verified destinations through dropdowns or location search where supported.
  • Keep API keys, origins, request limits, usage counters, and caches separate for each provider account.
  • Set a default weight for products without a weight and configure the rate cache lifetime in seconds.
  • Show optional cheapest and fastest badges and sort shipping rates.
  • Monitor daily and monthly rate requests, estimated costs, and optional usage warning emails.
  • Check rates, clear shipping caches, and import or export settings from Tools. API keys are excluded from exports.
  • Retain shared courier and service selections when switching providers. Only supported selections can return rates.

Choose your shipping API provider

Choose api.co.id, RajaOngkir / Komerce, or Biteship, then connect your account and API key. Each provider’s settings and origin are stored separately. When you switch providers, the plugin matches the origin when possible and preserves your current selection if matching fails.

Configure shipping and monitor API usage

Set your shipping origin, courier services, and product weights. The default weight applies when a product has no weight. In Checkout, configure destination selection, rate badges, and sorting. Caching, the usage dashboard, request limits, and optional warning emails help you manage API usage. Cost estimates may differ from your provider’s bill.

Rates and service terms

JagoOngkir is an independent integration. Rates come from your selected API provider and may differ between providers or from direct courier quotes. The courier determines the final charge when the parcel is processed. API fees, quotas, and privacy policies are subject to each provider’s terms. See External services and Privacy for details.

Compatibility and scope

Supports IDR, classic WooCommerce Cart and Checkout, and HPOS. Use [woocommerce_cart] and [woocommerce_checkout]. The plugin calculates shipping rates only; it does not book shipments, arrange pickups, or track parcels.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.3 or later.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.
  • WooCommerce 8.2 or later.
  • A provider account with access to shipping rate and location APIs.

External services

JagoOngkir sends requests from your WordPress server to a configured provider when an administrator tests the connection, searches for or validates a location, or checks shipping rates. Location searches and rate requests use the active provider. Location requests may also run in the background to prepare location lists. Activating the plugin alone does not contact providers; an API key must be configured first.

Providers receive the location and package details needed for each request, along with the server IP address and standard HTTP metadata. Customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, and street addresses are not sent. Switching providers may trigger a location API request to match the shipping origin. Provider account fees and terms apply.

  • api.co.id: Documentation, terms, privacy. Requests use https://use.api.co.id/ with the x-api-co-id header. Location APIs provide province, city, and district hierarchies. Rate requests send origin and destination district codes and physical weight; parcel dimensions and item value are included when available. api.co.id calculates volumetric rates from the dimensions. The plugin estimates Rp5 for requests that return usable rates; actual charges follow the provider.
  • RajaOngkir / Komerce: Documentation, terms, privacy. Requests use https://rajaongkir.komerce.id/api/v1/ with the key header. The API provides location search and hierarchies. Rate requests send verified district IDs, weight in grams, courier codes, and price=lowest. When complete product dimensions are available, the plugin calculates volumetric weight using the divisor set in General and sends the greater of actual or volumetric weight. Fees and quotas depend on your account plan.
  • Biteship: Maps documentation, rates documentation, terms, privacy. Requests use https://api.biteship.com/v1/ with the Authorization header. The location API searches Indonesian areas. Rate requests send origin and destination area IDs, courier codes, and item weight, quantity, value, and dimensions. Missing dimensions are sent as 1 cm. Coordinates and shipment booking data are not sent. Fees and quotas depend on your account plan.

jQuery is provided by WordPress; SelectWoo and its stylesheet are provided by the installed WooCommerce plugin.

Privacy

Settings and API keys are stored in non-autoloaded WordPress options. Provider response and location caches are separated by account and stored in expiring WordPress transients rather than a permanent local location database. Verified customer addresses and rate metadata are stored through WooCommerce sessions and customer/order CRUD operations.

Provider location data and directories are cached for up to seven days. Search results are reused on the page for 60 seconds, or 10 seconds while location preparation is in progress. The default shipping rate cache lasts 24 hours (86,400 seconds) and can be configured from 1 to 86,400 seconds. Matching quotes are reused only until they expire. Existing cache settings are preserved. Daily usage details are retained for 90 days and monthly summaries for the last 13 recorded months per account. The dashboard shows all providers and filters for today, yesterday, this week, this month, and last month, using the site’s timezone and start-of-week setting. Older daily details may be incomplete because earlier versions retained only three days; available monthly summaries are preserved.

Optional usage warning emails are sent to the configured recipient through the WordPress mail service. The local location request limiter stores a keyed hash of the visitor’s IP address in WordPress options. The limiter does not send the visitor’s raw IP address to providers. Counters use one-minute intervals; the stored hash remains until a later request updates the counter state. Describe your store’s use of the selected providers in its privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce. Upload the jagoongkir folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate JagoOngkir from Plugins.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Ongkos Kirim > API Connection and enter your provider API key.
  3. Select the active provider in General. Set the Origin Location under Shipping Origin.
  4. Choose courier services and set the default product weight. Shipping becomes available automatically once the plugin is active and the API key and origin are configured.
  5. Configure destination selection, badges, and rate sorting in Checkout.
sections.faq:
Is JagoOngkir affiliated with the API providers or couriers?

No. JagoOngkir is an independent plugin that connects WooCommerce to third-party shipping APIs. It is not officially affiliated with any provider or courier company.

Do I need an API account?

Yes. Register with api.co.id, RajaOngkir / Komerce, or Biteship to get an API key for your chosen shipping service.

Are there API usage fees?

Fees, quotas, and API access depend on your provider account and plan. API fees are separate from parcel delivery charges. Check your provider’s current pricing and account terms.

Where do shipping rates come from?

Shipping rates and service availability come from your selected API provider. JagoOngkir displays the results returned by that provider.

How are dimensions and volumetric weight handled?

Biteship receives each item’s dimensions and quantity. api.co.id receives physical weight and estimated parcel length, width, and height in centimeters, rounded up to whole centimeters. Its API calculates volumetric rates; the plugin does not increase weight locally or recalculate api.co.id rates when a service is selected. Product dimensions are used automatically when complete. If complete dimensions are unavailable, api.co.id receives physical weight only. For api.co.id and RajaOngkir, the plugin estimates one parcel using the largest item’s length and width, plus the combined height of all items multiplied by quantity. RajaOngkir receives the greater of actual and locally calculated volumetric weight. The General tab shows a Volumetric weight divisor field only when RajaOngkir is active. The default is 6000 and applies to all RajaOngkir couriers and services. Before requesting rates, the plugin calculates length x width x height / divisor in kilograms and rounds up to grams. Selecting a courier does not change the divisor or trigger a separate volumetric adjustment request. All product measurements are converted from the WooCommerce dimension unit to centimeters. This is a packing estimate: packaging material and box fitting are not simulated, and oversized orders are not automatically split into multiple parcels. Final measurements and charges follow the courier.

Which weights are shown in Cart and Checkout?

The Checkout setting Show product and shipping weights below subtotal displays the physical product weight total and the post-volumetric weight for selected RajaOngkir services. Product weight includes the configured default for products without a weight. The calculated shipping weight does not include courier rounding or minimum billing rules. api.co.id and Biteship calculate dimensions remotely, so only physical product weight is shown for these providers; unverified shipping weight is not displayed.

Why can rates differ between providers or from direct courier quotes?

Providers may use different data sources or calculation methods. Weight rounding, package dimensions, coverage, and rate updates can also affect results. Final delivery charges follow the courier’s calculation when the parcel is processed.

Which terms and privacy policies apply?

API use is subject to the selected provider’s terms and privacy policy:

  • api.co.id: Terms and Privacy policy.
  • RajaOngkir: Terms and Privacy policy.
  • Biteship: Terms and Privacy policy.

Why are shipping rates missing?

Check your API key, provider balance or quota, origin, destination, product weights, and service selections. Rates may be unavailable during a provider outage or when a courier does not serve the route. After switching providers, select the destination again so the active provider can verify it.

Is customer information sent to the API provider?

The plugin sends origin and destination location data and the package information needed for a quote. Customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, and street addresses are not sent. See External services and Privacy below.

Can JagoOngkir book or track shipments?

No. The plugin only displays shipping rates from the provider. It does not book shipments, arrange pickups, or track parcels.

Does the plugin support Cart and Checkout Blocks?

No. Use the classic [woocommerce_cart] and [woocommerce_checkout] shortcodes.

Can I change providers without losing my settings?

Yes. Provider profiles and account-specific caches are retained. The plugin matches the saved origin by province, city/regency, and district names, and by postal code for Biteship when available. It saves the matched destination using the target provider’s own IDs and retains the previous provider’s origin. If no origin is configured, it restores the target provider’s saved settings. Shared courier and service selections are retained. Only matching, unexpired quotes are reused.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • fix: Show the effective Direct Search method for Biteship and disable its unsupported Step-by-Step option, while retaining the saved method preference for other providers.
  • new: Add administrator shipping diagnostics in Tools, optional test parcel dimensions, cache reuse, and store-selection indicators for returned services. Diagnostics exclude API keys and raw provider responses.
  • new: Add automatic volumetric weight calculation for RajaOngkir using combined parcel dimensions. Send the greater of actual and volumetric weight to the API.
  • new: Add a configurable RajaOngkir volumetric weight divisor in General, defaulting to 6000 for all couriers and services.
  • improve: Automatically match the saved shipping origin when switching providers, keeping separate origin profiles and provider-specific IDs. Preserve the active provider if matching fails.
  • fix: Exclude bundled translation catalogs from the WordPress.org release package so translations can be distributed through translate.wordpress.org.

1.0.0

  • new: Initial release.
